title: World's Largest Companies by Market Cap
subtitle: 2009 to 2026
hook: Watch how the world's largest companies by market cap shifted dramatically over nearly two decades.
setup: This data race tracks market capitalization leaders and major movers from 2009 through 2026.

sequence.text: Alphabet (Google) enters the ranking in 2013 at rank 2 with a market capitalization of 359,503,600,000 USD.
Saudi Aramco debuts in 2018 taking rank 1 with a market capitalization of 1,880,822,600,000 USD.
NVIDIA makes a massive jump in 2024 climbing from rank 6 to rank 2 with 3,288,762,100,000 USD.

ending: The evolving market capitalization standings highlight the dynamic shifts among the world's most valuable companies up to 2026.
